verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only installation paths: a Claude Code plugin marketplace add/install command, copying the skill folder, uploading a zip, or running a packaging script. It never mentions updating, auto-updates, or an update command. Any update behaviour of the host plugin marketplace is a platform capability, not one the product documents, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch
